name: Contributor Publication Data 1
definition: Data related to the transaction published by a contributor.

ReceptionDateTime.name: Reception Date Time
ReceptionDateTime.definition: Date and time when the transaction report was received by an Approved Publication Arrangement (APA).||Usage: Only applicable for input data.

PublicationDateTime.name: Publication Date Time
PublicationDateTime.definition: Date and time when the transaction was published by a trading venue or Approved Publication Arrangement (APA).

PublicationVenueIdentification.name: Publication Venue Identification
PublicationVenueIdentification.definition: Identifies the trading venue and Approved Publication Arrangement (APA) publishing the transaction.
